active_service_hours: 06:00-23:00 local time (102 ten-minute bins per day)

time_split.continuity_rule: all 6 history intervals and target must be exactly 10 minutes apart; samples never cross overnight gaps

coordinate_assumptions.station_coordinates: CRS is not declared; local station coordinates are treated as WGS84-compatible based on comparison with public map coordinates (inference)
coordinate_assumptions.housing_coordinates: Baidu Maps coordinates treated as BD-09 and converted approximately to WGS84
coordinate_assumptions.housing_coordinate_conversion: BD-09 -> GCJ-02 -> approximate inverse GCJ-02 -> WGS84

od_semantics: directed count of passenger trips; absent station-pair rows in a documented complete sparse time bin mean zero flow
housing_price_source: 2017 AnJuKe residential-estate average price; published source does not specify a unit in the local file description, so only relative station-level rankings are used

label_definition.group_0: economically advantaged proxy: station housing-price median >= median over all labeled station medians
label_definition.group_1: economically disadvantaged proxy: station housing-price median < median over all labeled station medians
label_definition.group_minus_1: unknown: no valid residential complex within 800 m
label_definition.fairod_mapping: group 0 is advantaged; group 1 is disadvantaged; -1 is excluded from group fairness gaps

warnings: The 2017 housing-price proxy is an area-level context attribute, not a passenger income label.
Station CRS is not declared in the local MetroFlow file; WGS84 compatibility is inferred from a public-coordinate spot check.
Baidu housing coordinates are converted approximately from BD-09 to WGS84 before spatial matching.
All Shanghai housing records outside the documented city bounding box and one row with missing values are excluded.
The OD tensor stores only the 117 complete days; overnight gaps remain explicit in timestamps and are excluded from temporal windows.
